entries.title: I Samuel 24:2
segments:
Rocks of the wild goats; the wild, uncultivated regions inhabited by those animals. 
 
Where the heart is not duly humbled and turned from the love of sin, men will continue in some form to practise it.  When disappointed in one way they will pursue it in another, and nothing but the grace of God will lead them wholly to forsake it.

entries.title: I Samuel 24:3
segments: A cave; caves in that country are often large enough to contain hundreds of men.

entries.title: I Samuel 24:4
segments: We should be very careful not to interpret the opportunity and inclination for iniquity as a license from God to commit it.

entries.title: I Samuel 24:5
segments: David's heart smote him; fearing he had done wrong in cutting off Saul's skirt, and had not treated him whom God had made king with proper respect.

entries.title: I Samuel 24:6
segments: Conscientious regard to propriety in the treatment of those whom God has raised to be rulers, will ever characterize his enlightened and consistent friends.  Yet this will not lead them to justify their errors, nor hinder them from condemning their vices.

entries.title: I Samuel 24:7
segments: To be accepted of God, we must not only abstain from evil ourselves, but must use our influence to prevent it in others.

entries.title: I Samuel 24:9
segments: It is highly honorable to religion, when the conduct of its friends shows that the slanders of their enemies are false.

entries.title: I Samuel 24:13
segments:
Wickedness--from the wicked; if David had been wicked, and sought Saul's life, he would have killed him.  But as he did not, it showed that he was not thus wicked. 
 
The conduct of men is the best evidence of their character, and they should ever so act as to show supreme regard to God and good will to men.

entries.title: I Samuel 24:14
segments: After a dead dog; one insignificant and worthless.

entries.title: I Samuel 24:16
segments: Wicked men often see that they are wicked, that the righteous are more excellent and more happy than they, and that their end will be more glorious.

entries.title: I Samuel 24:21
segments: Not destroy my name; by cutting off his posterity.
